ui.title: Kitchen Quiz
ui.p: Ideas from thousands of family reviews of grocery and meal apps. Rate each one 1 to 10. 10 = love it! Tap 🤔 Other to say how you'd do it.
ui.other: Instead of "%s", how would you do it? Say it or type it.

about: The #1 thing people love: "I used the last of something, so I just asked the speaker to add it. No phone, no forgetting." When voice breaks, families switch apps.
Parents are surprised: kids like a simple rotation (tacos, spaghetti…). Some families use a week 1 / week 2 list.
Whoever gets to the store first uses the list, and checking something off removes it for everyone. No double buying.
Rate each card 1 to 10 (10 = love it, 1 = no way), or tap 🤔 Other and say what you'd do instead. Got an idea? Tap 🎤.

ideas.title: "Hey Google, add milk"
ideas.desc: Say it to any Google speaker (bedroom or kitchen) and it shows up on the hub's grocery list.

ideas.title: Grocery list on the hub
ideas.desc: A big list on the screen that's the same list on everyone's phone. Tap to check things off.

ideas.title: This week's dinners
ideas.desc: The home screen shows what's for dinner tonight and this week.

ideas.title: Dinner rotation
ideas.desc: A week 1 / week 2 list of our favorite dinners, so planning takes seconds.

ideas.title: New recipe vote
ideas.desc: Try one new recipe a week. Everyone votes: keep it or burn it.

ideas.title: Kids pick a dinner
ideas.desc: Each kid picks one dinner a week from the favorites list.

ideas.title: Recipe → grocery list
ideas.desc: Tap a recipe and its ingredients go straight onto the list.

ideas.title: Sorted by store aisle
ideas.desc: The list is in the order of the aisles at our usual store. (Tap Other to tell us which store.)

ideas.title: Use Google Keep for the list
ideas.desc: It's free and works with our Nest speakers. (Other choice: AnyList, which is better for recipes but only does voice through Alexa.)

ideas.title: Snap a recipe
ideas.desc: Take a picture of a recipe card or cookbook page and it becomes a recipe on the hub (like snap-a-flyer).
